common.disclaimerPart1: The data provided by Stress Index are for informational purposes only and do not constitute a medical diagnosis. Heart rate variability (HRV) analysis is a functional assessment tool for the autonomic nervous system and in no way replaces a physician's clinical examination, diagnosis or therapy.
